Do not add replacement words, numerals or symbols. Keep the actual USB-A and USB-C sockets, their shapes and order, power button, headphone jack and icon, vent slats, Dell chassis mark, the supporting hand, every finger, perspective, shadows, all existing title/model/subtitle text, circular logo, pale blue background and the exact composition unchanged. No other retouching. Preserve the full wide canvas and all text. The intended result differs only in the two tiny malformed lettering patches. No new product claims or new design.
